project_type: Go backend (REST API with go-chi) + Angular v22 frontend
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'go build ./...' to verify compilation. 2. Run 'go test ./internal/sbommon/ -v -count=1' to verify unit tests pass.
setup_instructions: Go 1.26.5 is available. Run 'go build ./...' to download deps and verify compilation.
environment_constraints: No PostgreSQL available for integration tests. No pnpm/node available for UI build. Validate backend code by compilation and unit tests only. Validate migration SQL by syntax inspection.
contribution_requirements: TDD approach. Table-driven tests. Both up and down migrations required. Sequential migration numbering (next: 000032). Update .kiro/steering/erd.md when DB schema changes. Doc comments on exported functions. Use context.Context. Minimize external dependencies.
key_patterns: The sbommon package follows a clear pattern: store.go (interface), postgres.go (implementation), sbommon.go (domain types), handlers.go (HTTP handlers), handlers_test.go (tests using mockSBOMStore), scanner.go (business logic). Routes registered in internal/server/server.go under /api/v1/sbom. UI uses Angular signals, standalone components, TailwindCSS, i18n with @@syntax.
directory_structure: cmd/ (CLI entrypoint), internal/sbommon/ (SBOM monitoring module with handlers/store/scanner), internal/server/ (HTTP router), migrations/ (SQL up/down files), ui/src/app/ (Angular frontend with pages/services/models)
